results.scenario: As the seeded owner Ada North (subject auth0|6728f0a1b2c3d4e5f6789012), this flow walks the complete supplier-payment journey over the MCP server: Step 1 authenticates with AuthClient.getTokenByPassword and resets the Low Street Print invoice (10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) to unpaid status in Postgres directly, ensuring the flow is repeatable. Step 2 calls the list_invoices MCP tool and verifies the invoice array contains that invoice with status "unpaid". Step 3 calls pay_invoice with the invoice id and the Operating GBP account id (10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000021), verifying alreadyPaid is false and capturing the returned transactionId. Step 4 calls get_invoice for the same invoice id and asserts the full InvoiceView response: status is "paid", paidFromAccountId matches the Operating GBP account, paidTransactionId matches the value returned by pay_invoice, paidAt is a non-null ISO-8601 timestamp, counterparty is "Low Street Print", amountMinor is 240000, currency is "GBP", dueOn is a YYYY-MM-DD string matching the value from list_invoices, and the object shape contains exactly those nine InvoiceView keys with no others. The flow also verifies persisted state directly in Postgres: the invoices row has status "paid" with the correct paid_from_account_id, paid_transaction_id, and a non-null paid_at; exactly one transactions row exists with the returned transaction id, with kind "debit", amount_minor 240000, currency "GBP", account_id matching the Operating GBP account, description "Supplier payment — Low Street Print", and organization_id matching Northwharf Ltd; and the Operating GBP account balance_minor decreased by exactly 240000. The cleanup step restores the invoice to unpaid, deletes the created transaction, credits the amount back to the account, and closes the database connection, so the flow can run repeatedly against the same seeded ledger.

stepsValidation.description: Authenticate as Ada North and reset the invoice to unpaid
List invoices and find the Low Street Print invoice
Pay the invoice from the Operating GBP account
Read the invoice back and prove it is paid
